pretreatments.description: Mechanical pre-treatment: The A. tequilana bagasse fibers were dried at room temperature and then reduced to an average length of 0.5 cm using a blade mill prior to any chemical treatment.

Acid hydrolysis pretreatment: Bagasse was dispersed at 5% (w/v) in either hydrochloric acid (HCl) or sulfuric acid (H2SO4) solutions at different concentrations and subjected to reactions in 1 L Corning bottles at varying temperatures and hydrolysis times. The acid concentration, temperature, and hydrolysis time varied according to experimental designs for sugar and methane optimization.
